_comment: Editorial illustrations for content pages. Prompts live here, not in the page,
so an image can be regenerated byte-for-byte from (prompt, seed, model).
The three prompt blocks ([STYLE]/[SUBJECT]/[NOT]) are composed by
scripts/gen-illustration.mjs; `scene` below is the [SUBJECT] line, `style` is
the [STYLE] line (overridable per preset for the style candidates), and [NOT]
is fixed there because it is load-bearing — see that file's header.
'size' is what we send as image_size, but the provider ignores it and always
returns a square (checked 2026-09-23). 'frame' is what actually decides the
shape: the generator crops the square to that ratio and writes 'outSize'.
A page may only declare the dimensions the file really has.
No text in the prompt on purpose — image models draw garbage lettering, and
every label that matters is set as live HTML next to the figure.
style: A fine-line engraving illustration, in the manner of a 19th-century technical plate. Single subject, generous empty space, warm paper background (#f4efe6), one accent colour only. Cross-hatching for shading. No gradients. Aspect ratio 16:9.

cand-laya-concrete-vs-jev.scene: A wooden bench in a workshop: on the left an open desktop computer with its side panel removed and a bare green circuit board standing against it, lit by a small desk lamp; on the right, behind a glass-fronted cabinet door with a padlock, a rack of identical flat metal server boxes with a cable running out of the cabinet.

cand-laya-concrete-self-host.scene: A small brass engine on a workbench with a punched paper tape feeding into its rollers, wired by two thick cables to a household electricity meter mounted beside it on the same bench, with a tool roll and an oil can on the bench.

cover-laya-topic.scene: A small brass instrument with three round dials standing on a workbench beside an open laptop, the two joined by a short cable; a narrow punched paper tape trails from the instrument across the bench.

cover-laya-vs-jev.scene: Two identical wooden chests standing side by side on a plain bench: the left one is closed and a brass padlock hangs from its hasp, the right one is open with its lid tilted back and holds a single small brass instrument.

cover-laya-self-hosting.scene: A small brass engine bolted to a single wooden workbench under one hanging lamp, driven by a narrow strip of paper feeding into its rollers, a folded cloth and an oil can beside it.

cover-laya-open-weights.scene: An open wooden crate of identical brass gears standing on a bench, one gear lifted out with tongs and held up to the light, a folded sheet of engineering drawings lying beside the crate.

jev-hero.scene: A dense wall of dark empty speech bubbles fills the left half; on the right, one calm figure seen from behind holds up a single blank white card.

jev-inspector.scene: An inspector in a work coat stands beside a conveyor belt of paper forms, each sheet already stamped with one single geometric mark; he looks at the sheets, not at a screen.

cand-a-line.scene: A single sheet of paper passing under a stamping press; around it a crowd of blank speech bubbles of different sizes, every one of them empty.
cand-a-line.style: fine cross-hatched engraving line work, warm ivory paper background, deep warm charcoal ink with one ink-blue accent, restrained editorial illustration, no text, no letters, no words, no signature, flat print texture, generous margins

cand-b-woodcut.scene: A single sheet of paper passing under a stamping press; around it a crowd of blank speech bubbles of different sizes, every one of them empty.
cand-b-woodcut.style: bold woodcut and linocut carving, thick gouged lines, large flat black masses, warm ivory paper, one rust-red accent, rough carved edges and visible grain, editorial print, no text, no letters, no words, no signature

cand-c-plate.scene: A single sheet of paper passing under a stamping press; around it a crowd of blank speech bubbles of different sizes, every one of them empty.
cand-c-plate.style: nineteenth-century technical plate drawing, precise thin ruled lines with stipple shading, warm ivory paper background, single ink-blue accent, measured diagrammatic composition, no text, no letters, no words, no signature, generous margins

cover-jev-topic.scene: A tall brass mailbox bolted to a wooden bench: a page of handwriting is being fed into its slot at the top, and a small punched brass card is falling into the tray at the bottom, with three more punched cards stacked beside the tray.

cover-jev-guide.scene: A wooden table seen slightly from above with six small objects laid out in a row, each on its own square of paper: a chess knight, a stopwatch, a joystick, a pair of dice, a paint tin and a metronome.

cover-alpha-line.scene: A wooden shelf holding a row of identical plain boxes, each with a blank paper tag tied to its handle; the leftmost box stands open with a brass instrument visible inside, and the box at the far end is empty with its lid ajar.

cover-jev-pricing.scene: A small brass adding machine on a workbench with a narrow paper tape curling out of its side, a short stack of coins beside it and a pair of tweezers holding one coin above the stack.

cover-jev-vs-llm.scene: Two machines side by side on an ivory workbench: on the left a long ribbon of unspooling paper covered in dense handwriting, on the right a shallow brass tray of small identical stamped discs, one disc being lifted by a mechanical finger.

cover-jev-open-source.scene: A workshop bench: four hand-built copies of the same brass instrument, in different sizes and finishes, each standing on its own square of cloth; behind them on a shelf, one polished original under a glass dome.
